allowed_readings: Read current Body War business concepts, their meanings, source provenance, confidence, workflow status, and explicit relations.
Read blocked and deferred concepts as visible candidate residue.
Read the login-to-score-preview path as a candidate local prototype model with separate fixture and real-provider evidence ceilings.
Use the graph as input to a later DomainSpec bridge only after the selected ontology nodes and digests are explicitly bound.
forbidden_authority_moves: Branch membership does not promote a term into CyberAlchemy definitions or ontology authority.
Candidate status does not establish business lifecycle state.
A relation does not create executable logic or runtime behavior.
SuggestedTrack evidence or GeometryCandidate does not create source-backed geometry.
ScorePreview does not establish verified score, controller, conquest, release, or production authority.
The ontology cannot ratify score, privacy, anti-cheat, economy, territory, or promotion policy.
residue: ScorePolicy normalizers, aggregation, window identity, history scope, and rounding require owner decision.
Activity-derived geometry privacy, precision, retention, deletion, and promotion require owner decisions.
The controller metric boundary between fastest verified time and Zone Score remains unresolved.
Anti-cheat strictness, economy, sponsored-zone, and city rollout rules remain deferred.
DomainSpec executable binding and application implementation are separate later packages.
